Master's degree in the life sciences, preferably Biology, Molecular and Cell Biology, Biochemistry. (Preferred)
Bachelor's degree in the life sciences, preferably Biology, Molecular and Cell Biology, Biochemistry.
Experience with sterile tissue culture techniques, PCR, basic lab maintenance duties, excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
1-year (cumulative) experience working in a biology research lab.
Experience with molecular biology techniques, plasmid handling and molecular cloning.
Experience with human pluripotent stem cell culturing, genome engineering with CRISPR, as well as the library prep and data analysis of next generation sequencing (NGS).

This Staff Research Associate 2 provides a variety of support and research functions within the lab for a 2-year project. This position assists lab members with molecular biology and tissue culture techniques, including the culture and maintenance of pluripotent stem cell cultures (hPSCs). The Staff Research Associate 2 supports a large-scale hPSCs genome engineering workflow involving genome editing, project tracking, and quality control. Additionally, this position works on various research projects involving the planning, design, and conduct of experiments under the supervision of the PI, while assisting with general lab operations, safety compliance, and supply management.
Stem Cell Culture and Genome Engineering - 30%

Cultures and maintains the pluripotent stem cell cultures (hPSCs) which includes the passaging of stem cell clones, isolation of genomic DNA and genotyping cells by PCR and sequencing. Support a large-scale hPSCs genome engineering workflow that involves genome editing, project tracking, quality control of reagents and materials, and report writing.
Molecular Biology and Tissue Culture Support - 25%

Standard molecular biology and tissue culture techniques. Assists lab members with the maintenance and characterization of human stem cell cultures and genotyping of stem cells which entails the isolation of DNA from human stem cells, amplifying DNA by PCR and preparing samples for sequence analysis. This genotyping will require daily record keeping in laboratory notebook to record the samples analyzed and the attendance at weekly lab meetings to understand the basic objectives of the research project.
Research Project Support - 25%

Assists with research projects including optimizing and testing tissue culture and molecular biology protocols such as molecular cloning, stem cell differentiation and library screening. This will be done with the guidance of the PI and other lab members.

Plans and designs the experiments discussing the outline of the experiment/ protocol with the PI, conducting the experiments, analyzing results and interpreting data under the supervision of the PI. Troubleshoots experiments which include PCR and genotyping.
Safety and Protocol Compliance - 10%
Assisting with protocol renewals and safety inspections.
Lab Support Operations - 10%
Lab support duties including autoclaving waste and ordering and restocking supplies.
Knowledge of lab safety procedures, capability to design and conduct experiments and analyze data.
